speaker: Doctor
text: I'm Dr. Agent, and I'll be helping you today. Could you tell me how long you've been experiencing this fatigue, malaise, and unintentional weight loss?

speaker: Patient
text: 71-year-old male. The patient complains of fatigue and malaise over the last few months. He also reports an unintentional weight loss of 18.1 kg over the past 6 months. He does not recall any changes in diet or exercise routines that could explain the weight loss.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any changes in your bowel habits, such as blood in your stool, or any abdominal pain? I also need to know if you have had any fevers, night sweats, or persistent coughing.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue and malaise. I also have Significant unintentional weight loss, No change in diet or exercise.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any visible blood in your stool or experienced changes in your bowel habits, such as constipation or diarrhea? I also need to know if you have had any abdominal pain, fevers, or night sweats.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Has a history of diabetes mellitus type II, hypertension, non-seminomatous testicular cancer treated in the past, and hypercholesterolemia. Social history: Currently smokes 1 pack of cigarettes per day and drinks a glass of wine daily. Denies any illicit drug use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of testicular cancer and significant weight loss, I need to rule out metastasis or a new primary malignancy. REQUEST TEST: CT Abdomen_Pelvis, REQUEST TEST: CEA, REQUEST TEST: CA-19-9

speaker: Doctor
text: With a normal CT abdomen and pelvis, I need to look elsewhere for the source of your weight loss. REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray, REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Chest X-Ray: NORMAL READINGS; Complete Blood Count: WBC Elevated with lymphocytosis, Hemoglobin Normal to slightly decreased, Platelets Normal to decreased

speaker: Doctor
text: The lymphocytosis and your smoking history raise suspicion for Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL). I will order a Peripheral Blood Smear and Flow Cytometry to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Peripheral_Blood_Smear, REQUEST TEST: Flow_Cytometry

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Flow Cytometry: Presence of monoclonal B lymphocytes with a phenotype consistent with CLL/SLL.

speaker: Doctor
text: The flow cytometry results confirming monoclonal B lymphocytes are diagnostic. DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia
